description: Post an LFG on LFG Atlas FOR THE USER, only when they asked you to, using THEIR OWN contact (Discord invite, Discord username or in-game name). Never post on behalf of anyone else or copy other people's messages. Same rules as the website: no links in text, no trade/scam ads, 1 post per 15 seconds and 10 live posts per contact, plus generous rate limits; an exact duplicate of a live post returns the existing post (duplicate:true). Returns the post link and PRIVATE manage links to give only to the user.

consent.description: true = the player behind this contact asked for this post. Never post other people's messages.

contact.description: The player's OWN contact: discord.gg/xxxx invite, Discord username, or in-game name

contact_kind.description: Optional; guessed from contact if omitted

details.description: Game-specific fields from GET /api/games/{slug} (key without x_), e.g. {"map": "Mirage"} for cs2 or {"wipe": "Weekly"} for rust. Option fields must use one of the listed options.

game.description: Game slug from list_games / /api/games, e.g. cs2, valorant, osrs

hours.description: How long it stays up: lfg/lfm 1–24 (default 3), ready_now 0.5–3, server/clan listings up to 720 (30 days, default; renewable), squad 24–168

mode.description: Activity/mode, ideally from the game's modes list

rank.description: Ideally one of the game's rank options (get_game_filters)

ready_now.description: Playing right now (lfg/lfm only, lasts 30 min–3 h)

region.description: Recommended (optional): region/server, ideally one from the game's regions list

role.description: Ideally one of the game's role options

source.description: Optional short name of your app/agent (default: mcp-agent)

squad_days.description: Required for squad posts, e.g. Mon, Wed, Fri

type.description: lfg = player wants a group; lfm = group needs players; server; clan; squad (regular group)

name: create_post
title: Create an LFG post
